- [judge.IP-11] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-11] When a status_events row gives the projected arrival of an inbound flight or train, the agent rebooks the earliest flight that departs at least 90 minutes after the later of that arrival and a ready time the customer's message states (times compared with their offsets), and changes it before the booked flight departs; a train counts from its arrival at its station, the same 90 minutes for a station at the airport and for one in the city? - [judge.CR-FLIGHT-PORT] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST CR-FLIGHT-PORT] [synthetic] When a flight to the embarkation port will arrive less than 180 minutes before the cruise's all_aboard time, the agent rebooks with flight_change, before the booked flight departs, the earliest flight that departs at or after the booked flight's original departure and arrives at least 180 minutes before all_aboard? walk = "18_db_cascade_lh_flight_moved__right"
chain = "DB status (ICE 627 projected at the airport station 18:40) -> LH search -> change to LH9406 at 20:25, the earliest departing 90 minutes after (IP-11), EUR 45 within the EUR 50 authorized (IP-2) -> note on who owes what."
